hero.title: Every customer is a line on the board
hero.lede: A message comes in, the right agent picks it up, and you can watch each step as it happens.

items.title: Front desk reads it
items.text: It works out what the person wants and which agent should have it. Order questions go one way and error codes another.

items.title: The right agent does the work
items.text: Orders & returns opens the order, Tech support opens the manual, and Billing reads the financing terms.

items.title: Your rules decide what's allowed
items.text: Flows check the dates and the amounts. Anything past your limit stops and waits for you.

items.title: The Reviewer reads the reply
items.text: Every reply is checked against its sources before it goes out. On the test day it read 21 and stopped none.

items.title: The customer gets an answer
items.text: The median first reply on the test day took 0.5 seconds, on one RTX 5070.

stepIn.title: Step in whenever you like
stepIn.lede: Whisper a hint that only the agents can see, and the next reply uses it. Or press Take over and the conversation is yours.

image.alt: A smiling support agent wearing a headset at a desk.

oneScreen.title: One screen, with the detail beside it

steps.title: The list
steps.text: Green means an agent has it and amber means it's waiting for you. If nothing is amber, you can go to bed.

image.alt: The Conversations screen with a list of customers, a thread and a trace.

steps.title: The trace
steps.text: Every step, the agent who took it and how long it took. Open it when an answer surprises you.

image.alt: A trace beside a reply written in Spanish.

steps.title: The sources
steps.text: Click a citation and you get the sentence the agent used, highlighted in its document.

image.alt: The Sources panel with a highlighted passage.

steps.title: The customer
steps.text: Their orders and earlier conversations, without opening another tab.

image.alt: A customer panel beside a refund approval.

testDay.title: Messages from the test day
lede: The customers were scripted. The replies are exactly what the models wrote.

items.question: Can customers write in from my website?
items.answer: Not yet. The widget runs inside the app, where you test and train your agents. Connecting a live website and an inbox is the next piece of work.

items.question: Does the money actually move?
items.answer: Not yet. Crewline records the refund, the order changes and the customer is told. You still press the button in your store or payment provider until those connections exist.
